note: Set A binds nearly all claims correctly to the right schedule rows (e.g., F2 faucet model BSP-L-65014LF-PC, MWD02 and MWL01 millwork dimensions, EX/RF/CW locations), with only three truncated values ("TIERRA S" for TIERRA SOL twice, "PORCELA" for PORCELAIN). Set B has more substantive errors: it misreads FRANKE as RANKE, truncates the TOTO model C454CUFG#01 to 454CUFG#01 and the Delta valve T17059 to T1, gives F1's description as "FA" instead of BED, and misbinds the accent paint finish/colour to WB (wall base, which is MDF). B does capture a few good facts A misses (revision 3 date, glass tile colour, VT length), but its five wrong claims outweigh A's three minor truncations.
